# Vocabulary is FIELD · BRANCH and closed: tools/subject_tags.py holds the list and
# refuses anything else. A new section is added there first, on purpose.
# secondary is optional. PROFILE marks a Scientist Gallery portrait (the primary is the
# person's field). SERIES APPARATUS is contents/hub/redirect: meta only, no pill.
